scope: Fixed-descriptor/default mechanism diagnostic through actual startup, profiler and SGLang layer graphs. Research only; no production change or serving-performance claim.

source_contract.variant: The same qualified FP8-only descriptor port plus fixture-owned validation callback in every cell; no configured-timer guard or old scoped-cache prototype.
source_contract.no_historical_pooling: Earlier source/hardware/protocol batches are context only, not additional trials in this current-source comparison.

qualified_source.version_limit: Official fallback package0.0.0+unknown/unknown; exact source manifests and native artifacts establish identity.

sequence: original auto_synthetic startup: all9profiles and9tactics per profile
record natural winner; reversible real cache scope for fixed explicit graph, real miss for default graph
numerical and changed-input guards;24paired retained layer-graph timing windows
prepare retained-synthetic input hashes and numerical reference after graph timing

12paired auto and12paired graph profiler rounds on retained synthetic M144 profiling operands, balanced objective and pair orders; NaN output refresh before each timed profiler call, numerical check after
native acceptance on captured serving and retained synthetic operands; synthetic changed-input/restored-input guards
trace the SAME original layer graphs after all timing; final state and unchanged-read-operand/cache checks
protocol.admission: One disposable block0 correctness-only process with profiling hashes and negative controls, excluded from all performance inference. Timing starts only after admission passes.

analysis.unit: Fresh process, n=8; dependent within-process windows are not independent observations. Same physical GPU/time window; no population inference.
analysis.primary: Original-history fixed-explicit/default profiler ratio from calls74/72 and median of24 paired layer-graph event ratios, reported jointly by process.
analysis.secondary: Median of12 paired profiler ratios per objective on same retained synthetic operands, with first-position strata and within-process graph-vs-auto ratio.
analysis.estimator: Geometric mean of8 process-level ratios; full range and signs.

uncertainty.method: Exploratory percentile bootstrap resampling entire processes, shared indices across metrics; 100000replicates, seed202610262200, type7 quantiles, nominal95% intervals.
uncertainty.limit: Small fixed workload cohort, multiple exploratory metrics, possible process dependence; intervals are descriptive, not a guarantee or production margin.

analysis.no_pooling: Historical result and admission not pooled; retain every planned outcome; no significance-driven retries.

stopping.integrity: Stop and preserve failed artifacts; revise source/protocol explicitly before a separately identified new attempt.
stopping.performance: Do not stop, retry, discard or expand based on timing sign.
stopping.resource: One exclusive H100 node; bounded allocation; release after preservation.

limits: Original candidate domain/order and recipe preserved; retaining references after final profile extends allocation lifetime into graph capture. This is not byte-identical historical execution.
Later direct pair measurements follow graph warmup/timing and use repeated preparation; they isolate the fixed pair under this declared history, not original search order.
Auto synthetic profiling uses generated activations; full SGLang graph uses captured serving activations plus quantization. This study does not isolate activation values.
Fixed explicit graph is deliberately selected through a reversible real cache insertion, irrespective of natural tuning winner; not a claim that startup chose it.
No synthetic bytes hashed inline during timing startup. Admission hashes and post-graph hashes establish recipe and retained operands, not original historical byte attestation.
Same qualified source with FP8-only descriptor port and validation callback; not a stock release comparison. No managed-cache migration, scoped prototype, distributed or full-model inference.
NaN refresh and comparison validate each full profiler invocation, not every internal warmup or timed iteration. Native acceptance and original serving-graph traces are separate controls.
